name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  induction post <;>
    simp only [substOld]
  all_goals
    repeat' split
    all_goals
      simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, List.Subset, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars,
        List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton, List.not_mem_nil] at *
      all_goals grind

name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  have app {a b c d : List Expression.Ident}
      (h : a.Subset c) (k : b.Subset d) : (a ++ b).Subset (c ++ d) :=
    List.Subset.app (List.subset_append_of_subset_left _ h)
      (List.subset_append_of_subset_right _ k)
  intro h
  induction h
  all_goals try exact List.nil_subset _
  all_goals try assumption
  all_goals try exact app ‹_› ‹_›
  all_goals try exact app (app ‹_› ‹_›) ‹_›
  rename_i hn ih₁ ih₂
  unfold extractOldExprVars
  split
  · exact fun _ hx => hx
  · next hf =>
    cases hn .oldPred
    exact False.elim (hf _ _ _ rfl)
  · exact app ih₁ ih₂

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  have ln := InitStatesLength hi
  have lu := UpdateStatesLength hu
  have hn := InitStatesNotDefined hi
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit ln (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' hn hu) (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  rw [InitStatesUpdated hi, UpdateStatesUpdated hu]
  unfold updatedStates
  rw [updatedStatesComm]
  · exact updatedStatesUpdate lu (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))
  · rw [List.unzip_zip lu, List.unzip_zip ln]
    intro k hk hk'
    simpa [hn k hk'] using UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x
  by_contra hx
  have hp : 0 < ⟪f x, f x⟫_ℝ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne real_inner_self_nonneg' (fun h => hx (inner_self_eq_zero'.mp h.symm))
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x) hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
    (hc.continuousAt.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hp))
  let b : ContDiffBump x := ⟨r / 2, r, half_pos hr, half_lt_self hr⟩
  have hn : ∀ y, 0 ≤ b y * ⟪f y, f x⟫_ℝ := by
    intro y
    by_cases hy : y ∈ Metric.ball x r
    · exact mul_nonneg b.nonneg (hball y hy).le
    · rw [b.zero_of_le_dist (le_of_not_gt hy), zero_mul]
  have hi := (b.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
    (μ := μ) b.hasCompactSupport.mul_right hn
    (mul_pos (b.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)) hp).ne'
  have hz := hg (fun y => b y • f x)
    (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨b.contDiff, b.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const)
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at hz
  exact hi.ne' hz

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd : ∀ j k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j)) :=
    fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hBt : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ
      (fun s => ∂[j] (fun y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)) x) :=
    fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)) x
  have hJt : Differentiable ℝ (fun s => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i) :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) x i
  have hg : (∑ j, ∂[j] (∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x) =
      𝓕.ε₀⁻¹ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x := by
    conv_lhs =>
      arg 2
      ext j
      rw [Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs j)]
    have he := congrArg (fun f : Space d → ℝ => ∂[i] f x)
      (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
    change ∂[i] (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) x = _ at he
    rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
      fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt)] at he
    simp only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis] at he
    rw [he]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
    rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_mul_const
      (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
        (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) t).differentiableAt]
    simp [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, mul_comm]
  change ∂ₜ (fun s => ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) s) t = _
  simp_rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
    (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _),
    time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  calc
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∑ j, ∂ₜ
        (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) t) -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      simp only [Time.deriv_eq]
      rw [fderiv_fun_sub
        ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
        (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt,
        fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt,
        fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt,
        fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt]
      simp
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) *(∑ j, ∂[j] (fun x => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x -
        ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x)) x -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      simp_rw [Finset.sum_apply, Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv
        (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _),
        time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ (hA.of_le (ENat.LEInfty.out))]
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
      simp only [← Pi.sub_def]
      simp only [Space.deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i _) (hEd _ i), Pi.sub_apply]
      simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub, hg]
      simp [FreeSpace.c_sq]
      field_simp

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let pb (b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : b ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
    Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b))
  change pb b (Basis.mem_span _ b)
  apply Submodule.span_induction
  · rintro x ⟨φs, rfl⟩
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul, pb]
    let pa (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : a ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
      Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs) =
      ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a* ofCrAnListF φs))
    change pa a (Basis.mem_span _ a)
    apply Submodule.span_induction
    · rintro x ⟨φs', rfl⟩
      simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul, pa]
      calc _
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
            ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs)))) := by
          conv_lhs =>
            rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
            simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
            rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
          rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
          simp only [map_smul, smul_sub]
          rw [smul_comm]
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
            (ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
              ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))))) := by
          have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [φ, ψ] φs
            (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
          rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs = φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs by simp, h1]
          have h2 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [ψ, φ] φs
            (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
          rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs = φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs by simp, h2]
          rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
          simp [ofCrAnListF_append, ofCrAnListF_cons, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_assoc]
      rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
      repeat rw [mul_assoc]
      rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
        ← ofCrAnListF_append]
      have h1 := insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs
      simp [decide_not, Bool.decide_and, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append] at h1 ⊢
      rw [← h1, ← crAnTimeOrderList]
      by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
      · simp [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq]
      · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (not_ne_iff.mp hq).symm,
          ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
    · simp only [map_mul, zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero, pa]
    · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
      simpa only [pa, add_mul, mul_add, map_add] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hpx hpy
    · intro x hx hm hpx
      simpa only [pa, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_smul] using congrArg (fun z => x • z) hpx
  · simp only [map_mul, mul_zero, map_zero, pb]
  · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
    simpa only [pb, mul_add, map_add, add_mul] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hpx hpy
  · intro x hx hm hpx
    simpa only [pb, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_smul] using congrArg (fun z => x • z) hpx

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    rcases ih_l rfl l.wf.2.1 with v | ⟨t', h⟩
    · rcases ih_r rfl r.wf.2.1 with w | ⟨t', h⟩
      · obtain ⟨σ, b, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs v
        exact ⟨_, Red.abs v.lc w⟩
      · exact ⟨_, Red.appᵣ v h⟩
    · exact ⟨_, Red.appₗ r.wf.2.1 h⟩
  case tapp d s ih =>
    cases lc with | tapp lc ty =>
      rcases ih rfl lc with v | ⟨t', h⟩
      · obtain ⟨σ, b, rfl⟩ := d.canonical_form_tabs v
        exact .inr ⟨_, Red.tabs v.lc ty⟩
      · exact .inr ⟨_, Red.tapp ty h⟩
  case case d _ _ ih _ _ =>
    obtain ⟨lc, b, c⟩ := body_case.mp lc
    rcases ih rfl lc with v | ⟨t', h⟩
    · obtain ⟨t', rfl | rfl⟩ := d.canonical_form_sum v <;>
        cases v <;> exact .inr ⟨_, by solve_by_elim [Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr]⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨_, Red.case h b c⟩
  case let' d _ ih _ =>
    obtain ⟨lc, b⟩ := body_let.mp lc
    rcases ih rfl lc with v | ⟨t', h⟩
      <;> exact .inr ⟨_, by solve_by_elim [Red.let_body, Red.let_bind]⟩
  case inl d _ ih | inr d _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl d.wf.2.1 with v | ⟨t', h⟩
    · exact .inl (by solve_by_elim [Value.inl, Value.inr])
    · exact .inr ⟨_, by solve_by_elim [Red.inl, Red.inr]⟩
  case abs => exact .inl (.abs lc)
  case tabs => exact .inl (.tabs lc)
  case sub d _ ih => exact ih rfl lc
  case var => grind

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case par a a' b b' ha hb iha ihb =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    case par a'' b'' ha' hb' =>
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hc'⟩ := iha ha'
      obtain ⟨d, hd, hd'⟩ := ihb hb'
      exact ⟨_, .par hc hd, .par hc' hd'⟩
    case red_I =>
      cases ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
    case red_K =>
      obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₂ a' ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_K .., hc⟩
    case red_S c d =>
      obtain ⟨c', d', hc, hd, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible c d a' ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par hc hb) (.par hd hb)⟩
  case red_I =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
    case par c d hc hd =>
      cases hc
      exact ⟨_, hd, .red_I _⟩
    case red_I => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_K c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K ..⟩
    case par d e hd he =>
      obtain ⟨d', hd', rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ d hd
      exact ⟨_, hd', .red_K ..⟩
    case red_K => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_S a b c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    case par d e hd he =>
      obtain ⟨a', b', ha, hb, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible a b d hd
      exact ⟨_, .par (.par ha he) (.par hb he), .red_S ..⟩
    case red_S => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s t hr μ
  constructor <;> intro u ht <;> cases hr with
  | choice h =>
    cases ht with
    | choiceL ht =>
      obtain ⟨v, hv, hb⟩ := (by first | exact h.follow_fst ht | exact h.follow_snd ht)
      exact ⟨v, Tr.choiceL hv, ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩
    | choiceR ht =>
      exact ⟨u, Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  | bisim h =>
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hb⟩ := (by first | exact h.follow_fst ht | exact h.follow_snd ht)
    exact ⟨v, hv, ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  unfold hammingClose
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let C_i := (BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_H := Code.distFromCode f C_i
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 (⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_i_plus_steps := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩
  let δ := fun (g : C_i) =>
    (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (show (δ '' Set.univ).Nonempty from
    ⟨_, ⟨⟨0, C_i.zero_mem⟩, Set.mem_univ _, rfl⟩⟩)
  have h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size : hammingDist f g ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    rw [show d_fw = δ g from hg.symm]
    let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
    letI : Fintype Y := Fintype.ofFinite Y
    let F := fun (y : sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩) => Finset.univ.image (qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
      (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) (y := y))
    have hsub : Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g.val x) ⊆ Y.toFinset.biUnion F := by
      intro x hx
      let y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      refine Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨y, Set.mem_toFinset.mpr
        ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, ?_⟩
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨_, Finset.mem_univ _,
        (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x y).mp rfl⟩
    apply (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans
    apply Finset.card_biUnion_le.trans
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ y ∈ Y.toFinset, 2 ^ steps := Finset.sum_le_sum fun y _ =>
        (Finset.card_image_le).trans_eq (Fintype.card_fin _)
      _ = Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
        rw [←Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, Set.toFinset_card, smul_eq_mul, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  have h_dist_bridge : d_H ≤ ((d_fw * 2 ^ steps : ℕ) : ℕ∞) :=
    (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g g.property).trans
      (ENat.coe_le_coe.mpr h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size)
  have h_fw_bound : 2 * d_fw ≤ d_i_plus_steps - 1 := by
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
  have h_algebraic_identity : (d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
    dsimp [d_i, d_i_plus_steps, BBF_CodeDistance]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add];
    have h1 : ℓ + 𝓡 - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - i := by omega
    have h2 : ℓ - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ - i := by omega
    rw [h1, h2]
  have h_nat : 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) < d_i := by
    have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) h_fw_bound
    rw [h_algebraic_identity, Nat.mul_assoc] at h
    exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le h
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_left' h_dist_bridge 2)
    (by simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
      (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr h_nat))

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  let x₀ := fiberMap 0
  let x₁ := fiberMap 1
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval
      (fiberMap k).val = y := by
    have h := iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)
    simp only [Subtype.eq_iff] at h
    rw [h.symm]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val
      ((is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i (steps := 1) (by omega)
        (x := fiberMap k) (y := y)).mpr
        (by rw [pointToIterateQuotientIndex_qMap_total_fiber_eq_self])).symm
  have h_fiber_diff : x₁.val - x₀.val = 1 := by
    have h0 := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0
    have h1 := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1
    change x₀ = _ at h0
    change x₁ = _ at h1
    rw [h1, h0]
    simp [Fin2ToF2, get_sDomain_basis, normalizedWᵢ_eval_βᵢ_eq_1]
  set P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  set P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h_P_i_eval := evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs
  have he (k : Fin 2) : P_i.eval (fiberMap k).val =
      P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [P_i, h_P_i_eval, Fin.eta, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
      hq k, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, P₀, P₁]
  change P_i.eval x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
    P_i.eval x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) = _
  rw [he 0, he 1]
  calc
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * ((1 - r_chal) * (x₁.val - x₀.val)) +
        P₁.eval y.val * ((x₁.val - x₀.val) * r_chal) := by ring
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal := by rw [h_fiber_diff]; ring
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      simp only [P_i_plus_1, P₀, P₁, new_coeffs, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
        intermediateEvaluationPoly]
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
        Finset.sum_mul, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  classical
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => exact fun h => False.elim (Nat.not_lt_zero _ h)
  | succ n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      simp only [zero_add, gt_iff_lt, zero_lt_one, ModuleCode, forall_const]
      intro u hp
      simp_rw [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation] at hp
      rw [prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (F := F) (P := fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e)] at hp
      simp only [Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hp
      have h := hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hp
      have hu : u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) := by
        funext i
        match i with
        | 0 => rfl
        | 1 => rfl
      exact hu ▸ h
    | succ n =>
      intro _ u hp
      let U₀ := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := n + 1) u).1
      let U₁ := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := n + 1) u).2
      have hs := prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun
        (F := F) (multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close (MC := MC) u e)
      have hr := prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε) u e (by
        rw [← hs]
        simpa only [Fin.init_def, ENNReal.coe_mul, ENNReal.coe_natCast,
          multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close,
          multilinearCombine_recursive_form (u := u)] using hp)
      have hc := correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor
        (ih := ih (Nat.succ_pos _)) (u := u)
      exact CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (C := (MC : Set (Word A ι))) (u := u) (e := e)
        (h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ (n + 1)) Nat.one_le_two_pow
          (⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (n + 1))) ι from U₀))
          (⋈|(show WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ (n + 1))) ι from U₁))
          (lt_of_lt_of_le hr
            (Pr_le_Pr_of_implies (D := $ᵖ F) (h_imp := fun r hr => hc ⟨r, hr⟩))))

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n)  := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let f (n : ℕ) (k : Fin 4) : Set.Icc B T := ⟨u (n + k), hB _⟩
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, he⟩ := Set.finite_univ.exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem
    (f := f) (fun _ => Set.mem_univ _)
  have heq (k : Fin 4) := congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun he k)
  have eqn (m : ℕ) : u (i + m) = u (j + m) := by
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h m ih =>
      by_cases hm : m < 4
      · exact heq ⟨m, hm⟩
      · have prev (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k ∧ k ≤ 4) :
            u (i + m - k) = u (j + m - k) := by
          simp only [Nat.add_sub_assoc (by omega : k ≤ m)]
          exact ih (m - k) (by omega)
        apply Int.cast_injective (α := ℝ)
        rw [(hu (i + m) (by omega)).1, (hu (j + m) (by omega)).1,
            prev 1 (by decide), prev 2 (by decide),
            prev 3 (by decide), prev 4 (by decide)]
  refine ⟨i, j - i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have h := (eqn (n - i)).symm
  simpa only [Nat.add_sub_of_le hn,
    show j + (n - i) = n + (j - i) by omega] using h

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have h (A : Set S) : Aᶜ ∈ P ↔ A ∉ P := by
    constructor
    · intro hc ha
      exact hPP A ha Aᶜ hc (Set.inter_compl_self A)
    · intro ha
      by_contra hc
      have missing (B : Set S) (hb : B ∉ P) : ∃ U ∈ P, B ∩ U = ∅ := by
        by_contra hn
        push_neg at hn
        exact hPS ⟨B, hb, fun U hu => (hn U hu).ne_empty⟩
      obtain ⟨U, hu, he⟩ := missing A ha
      obtain ⟨V, hv, hf⟩ := missing Aᶜ hc
      apply hPP U hu V hv
      apply Set.eq_empty_of_forall_not_mem
      intro x hx
      by_cases hxA : x ∈ A
      · exact Set.not_mem_empty x (he ▸ ⟨hxA, hx.1⟩)
      · exact Set.not_mem_empty x (hf ▸ ⟨hxA, hx.2⟩)
  have hc : P.card = Pᶜ.card := by
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ) <;>
      simp [h]
  have count := Finset.card_add_card_compl P
  rw [← hc, Fintype.card_set] at count
  rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel (show 1 ≤ Fintype.card S from Fintype.card_pos), pow_succ] at count
  omega

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  have step (d e : Fin 9 → ℤ) (h : relation d e) (i : Fin 9) :
      7 ∣ digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10^i.1 := by
    have eqn : digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then e j else d j) =
        digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10^i.1 := by
      rw [hdigits_to_num]
      dsimp only
      have : (fun j : Fin 9 => (if j = i then e j else d j) * 10^j.1) =
          (fun j => d j * 10^j.1 + if j = i then (e j - d j) * 10^j.1 else 0) := by
        funext j
        split_ifs <;> ring
      rw [this, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      simp
    rw [← eqn]
    exact ((hrelation d e).mp h).2 i
  intro d e f h i
  have hs := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun j _ => step d e h.1 j)
  have sum_eq : (∑ j : Fin 9, (digits_to_num d + (e j - d j) * 10^j.1)) =
      8 * digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e := by
    simp only [sub_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
      Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [hdigits_to_num]
    ring
  rw [sum_eq] at hs
  have ht : 7 ∣ (d i - f i) * 10^i.1 := by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hs
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := step d e h.1 i
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := step e f h.2 i
    refine ⟨a - b - c - digits_to_num d, ?_⟩
    linear_combination ha - hb - hc
  have hp : Prime (7 : ℤ) := Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr (by decide)
  exact (hp.dvd_mul.mp ht).resolve_right (fun hn => by
    have := hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hn
    norm_num at this)
